title: Blackwood Salt E-Liquid – Double Barrel 30ml
description:
Description
Sweet Spiced Tobacco. A sweet aged burley tobacco crumbled with mouth watering rich graham crackers, a touch of caramel, and finished with notes of cinnamon and vanilla. This incredible blend will bring out the sweet tooth in any tobacco lover.
30ml Bottle
50% VG 50% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Blackwood is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
